summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, submitting its financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026, as approved by the Board of Directors. The filing discloses net income of Ps. 78.4B for controlling interests, shareholders' equity of Ps. 4,023.6B, and that 66.55% of shares are held by controlling shareholder Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria S.A. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure required of foreign private issuers; it does not involve any transaction, corporate action, or special situation. The filing is purely a financial reporting obligation.
